items.question: How long does it take to develop a professional website?
items.answer: The timeline varies depending on the project's complexity and requirements. Simple websites take 2-4 weeks, while complex platforms may need 8-16 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline before starting each project.

items.question: Do you offer a quality guarantee on the websites you develop?

items.question: Are the websites you develop optimized for search engines?
items.answer: Of course! All our sites are developed according to SEO best practices with comprehensive optimization of code, content, and speed to ensure a strong presence in search results.

items.question: Can I manage the website content myself after delivery?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At CodeLegacy, we respect your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you visit our website or use our web development services, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We only collect the information needed to respond to you and deliver our services:
items: Contact details you give us, such as your name, email address and phone number, when you fill in a form, send us a message or contact us on WhatsApp.
Project details you share with us, such as your business type, requirements and any files or links you send.
Basic technical data collected automatically, such as browser type, device, pages visited and approximate location, to help us keep the website working and improve it.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
items: To reply to your enquiries and prepare quotes or proposals.
To design, build, deliver and support the websites and services you request.
To improve our website, services and user experience.
To send important updates about your project or our services. You can opt out of non-essential messages at any time.
To protect our website and prevent fraud or misuse.

sections.heading: Cookies and Analytics
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences and to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, although some parts of the website may not work as expected.

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share it only with trusted service providers who help us operate the website or deliver your project (for example hosting, email or analytics providers), and only as far as needed for that purpose. We may also disclose information if required by law.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services and Links
paragraphs: Our website may link to third-party websites and services, including our client projects, social media pages and WhatsApp. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those third parties, so please review their policies before sharing information with them.

sections.heading: Data Security and Retention
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information from unauthorised access, loss or misuse. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. We keep your information only for as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy or as required by law.

sections.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or object to how we use it. To make a request, please contact us and we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are intended for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page with its updated date. Continued use of the website after changes means you accept the updated policy.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully. They explain the rules for using the CodeLegacy website and for hiring us to design and build your website.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing this website or requesting any service from CodeLegacy, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or our services.

sections.heading: Our Services
paragraphs: We design and develop websites and web applications, including e-commerce stores, restaurant, clinic, business, educational and portfolio websites, landing pages, SaaS platforms and related services. The scope, features, timeline and price of each project are agreed with you in writing (a quote, proposal or message confirmation) before work starts.

sections.heading: Client Responsibilities
items: Provide accurate information, content, images, logos and feedback on time.
Make sure you have the right to use any content, trademarks or materials you give us.
Review deliverables and give approval or change requests within a reasonable time.
paragraphs: Delays in providing materials or feedback may extend the project timeline.

sections.heading: Payments
paragraphs: Prices, payment amounts and schedules are agreed before the project begins. Unless agreed otherwise, work starts after the initial payment is received, and the final delivery or launch is subject to payment of the remaining balance. Third-party costs such as domains, hosting, paid plugins or licences are not included unless stated in the quote.

sections.heading: Revisions and Changes in Scope
paragraphs: The agreed scope includes a reasonable number of revisions to the delivered work. Requests that go beyond the agreed scope, such as new features or a change of direction, may be quoted and scheduled separately.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: After full payment, you own the final website design and the content you supplied. We keep ownership of our pre-existing tools, code libraries, templates and know-how, and of any third-party or open-source components, which remain subject to their own licences. We may show the finished project in our portfolio unless you ask us in writing not to.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
paragraphs: We treat non-public information you share about your business and project as confidential and will not disclose it to third parties except as needed to deliver the work or as required by law.

sections.heading: Support and Maintenance
paragraphs: Support, maintenance and hosting terms, if included, are described in your quote or agreement. Anything not included there is handled as a separate service.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: We work to deliver high-quality results, but we do not guarantee specific business outcomes such as sales, rankings or traffic. To the fullest extent allowed by law, CodeLegacy is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us for the service concerned.

sections.heading: Cancellation
paragraphs: Either party may end a project by written notice. Work completed up to the date of cancellation, and any non-refundable third-party costs, remain payable.

sections.heading: Use of the Website
paragraphs: You agree not to misuse this website, including attempting to gain unauthorised access, interfering with its operation or copying content for unlawful purposes. Content on this website belongs to us or is used with permission.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. The latest version is always available on this page, and continued use of the website or services means you accept the updated terms.

hero.subtitle: Every project has its own scope. We review the need, then document the deliverables, milestones, and proposed price before delivery begins.

projects.title: Project
projects.text: Every project has its own scope. These are starting prices for typical projects; contact us to review your needs and receive a written proposal.

scope.title: What's Included vs. Excluded
scope.text: We believe in complete contractual clarity from day one to protect your investment and avoid scope surprises.
scope.includedSub: Standard, guaranteed deliverables baked into every proposal
included: Custom bespoke UI/UX design crafted in Figma (no generic templates)
Modern full-stack engineering (Next.js / React / TypeScript / Laravel)
100% mobile-first responsive layouts across all devices and screen sizes
Native bilingual Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) architecture
Full source code ownership, repository handover, and deployment docs
Technical SEO readiness, Core Web Vitals optimization, and Schema.org markup
Interactive contact forms, WhatsApp click-to-chat, and Google Analytics (GA4)
scope.excludedSub: Third-party platform fees or items billed as dedicated add-ons
excluded: Third-party SaaS subscriptions, gateway fees, or paid API licenses (billed directly by providers)
Specialized marketing copywriting or legal document translation (client-provided or quoted separately)
Professional product photography and custom high-end video production
Domain registration and dedicated cloud server hosting (we can manage both for you)
Major feature additions outside the signed milestone scope

payments.title: Milestone-Linked,
payments.text: You never pay 100% upfront. Payments are linked to verifiable deliverables that you review and approve.

phases.title: Deposit & Discovery Sign-Off
phases.text: Upon contract signing, project kickoff, UX wireframing, and design approval in Figma.

phases.title: Core Development & Beta Preview
phases.text: Access to a private staging environment to test functional features, review layouts, and populate content.

phases.title: Final QA, Launch & Handover
phases.text: After user acceptance testing (UAT), domain connection, production deployment, and full code handover.

annual.title: Expected Annual Running
annual.text: Building your custom website or app is a one-time investment; running it reliably requires predictable annual infrastructure expenses.

items.title: Domain Name (.com / .eg)
items.text: Annual registration of your brand's digital address to protect your digital identity.

items.title: Managed Cloud Hosting & Daily Backups
items.text: High-speed isolated server resources, daily automated offsite backups, and uptime monitoring.

items.title: SSL Certificates & WAF Protection
items.text: Automated SSL certificates, DDoS mitigation, and Cloudflare cloud edge firewall protection.

items.title: Technical Maintenance & Security Updates
items.text: Dependency upgrades, security patching, and on-call developer support for peace of mind.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text: Managed hosting options with plan-specific features such as backups, SSL certificates, and technical support.

estimator.title: Estimate your project cost
estimator.text: Interactive ranges based on 2026 Egypt and MENA market guides. A written proposal still follows discovery.

compact.label: Compact
compact.hint: About 5–8 pages or an MVP slice

standard.label: Standard

notes: Custom UI and Arabic RTL routing
Responsive build and technical SEO markup

estimator.cta: Request a detailed quote from these requirements

items.q: Are your prices in USD or EGP?
items.a: Starting prices on this page are shown in USD, and the estimator below also shows an EGP range for the Egyptian market. Your written proposal states the final price and currency clearly before any work begins.
Yes. You never pay 100% upfront. Payment is split across three milestones: 50% at kickoff and design approval, 30% at the staging preview, and 20% at final QA, launch and handover.

items.q: How is a project price set?
items.a: We review your requirements, then document the deliverables, milestones and proposed price in a written proposal. The number of pages or screens, integrations, backend complexity and content readiness are what move the price.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing maintenance after launch?
items.a: Every project includes a 30-day post-launch warranty with bug fixing. After that, optional maintenance plans start from $50 per month and cover dependency upgrades, security patching and developer support.
